scope: Building 3 session priorities, orange shade separation, fetch acknowledgement and cached classroom recommendations
github_policy: Local changes and Git records only; update GitHub solely on an explicit user request

afternoon: Period 5 busy and all periods 6-10 free: 1, small rooms first within this tier
priority.preceding_period: Only afternoon period 5 changes priority; unknown is never treated as busy
priority.palette: Original orange family, with stronger lightness separation; tier 1 background #edb17d, tier 2 #fbe3ca

fetch_workflow.order: Authorized QQ request -> successful acknowledgement -> query and cache -> image or explicit error
fetch_workflow.deduplication: Separate persisted acknowledgement and final-reply keys, with original incoming deduplication
fetch_workflow.quotas: Both replies count; preflight requires capacity for two ordinary replies
fetch_workflow.pause_or_permission_revocation: Rechecked before crawling and before final delivery
fetch_workflow.ack_failure_or_uncertain_delivery: No query and no automatic retry

memory.replacement: Latest successful snapshot for each date; restored after restart, with legacy latest.json fallback
memory.contents: Classroom facts and source timestamps only, no credentials or chat transcripts

recommendation.scope: Owner private or white group; gray denied before cache access
recommendation.bounded_arguments: Date, now/morning/afternoon/evening, limit 1-12 (default 8), optional three-digit current room to exclude
recommendation.clock: Actual server time converted to UTC+8; the user and model cannot supply now
recommendation.ended_intervals: Excluded; current-period usable time clipped to the actual clock
recommendation.network: Recommendation reads the cache and does not log into campus or fetch again
recommendation.model: Existing agent selects the cache tool, then a separate tools=[] model stage explains verified candidates
recommendation.output: Always retains code-generated candidates, current time, fetch time and availability window; rejects invented rooms/times or seat guarantees in explanation
recommendation.fallbacks: Explicit missing/expired cache, ended session/day, no eligible rooms; model failure retains verified candidates

tests.visual_check: 1800x4875 explicitly marked synthetic preview inspected; original orange family restored, tiers 1 and 2 clearly separated
tests.online_model: Both example questions selected cached recommendations and completed model explanation; 10 evening options and 8 current-time options
tests.earlier_online_transient: Initial model connection failure / facts-only fallback, followed by two successful requests; no repeated campus login

not_claimed: Live QQ acknowledgement plus image receipt

instant_recommendation_followup.rule: session=now: previous scheduled lesson busy and already ended without elapsed-time window, OR current lesson ends within 10 minutes and then contiguous free -> highest priority; pending release must wait until actual lesson end; includes noon/evening boundaries
instant_recommendation_followup.break_availability: May enter after the previous lesson ends without waiting for next lesson start
instant_recommendation_followup.output: just_released / release_pending flags passed to model and fixed list; pending release never claimed usable now
instant_recommendation_followup.unchanged: Explicit session rankings and full-day images
